InspectionStatus.description: Status of the inspection recorded on the lead itself, matching the legacy `inspection_status` column. The appointment has its own, richer lifecycle; this enum is the operator-facing projection.
InspectionStatus.title: InspectionStatus

LeadStatus.description: Sales pipeline stage. The transition map is the single source of truth; a controller may not move a lead to a stage the map forbids.
LeadStatus.title: LeadStatus

Region.description: The three service metros. A fixed enum, not a table: expanding to a fourth market is a business event that deserves a migration and a review, not a row an operator can create by accident.
Region.title: Region

StorePublicLeadRequest.description:
Public website form. The landing page posts snake_case JSON; the honeypot
fields are intentionally not listed here (SpamProtection reads the whole
request) and `source` is server-set, never client-provided.
StorePublicLeadRequest.title: StorePublicLeadRequest

website.description:
These values become public hrefs: restrict the scheme so a

user_id.description:
Ownership is server-side only. A client that tries to set it gets a
422 rather than silently creating a row for another user.
